races.paceDynamic: Tricky Jenny is the sole confirmed front-runner and will get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from other early speed. The prominent runners Tree Wizard and Lairy Mary will track behind but neither has shown enough early pace to challenge Jenny's position. With most runners having hold-up styles (Toon Army, Penny Arcade, Jimmy You Mushroom, Spirit Of Mary), this creates a tactical setup where the pace will be moderate early before quickening. This race shape strongly favours prominent and front-running types who can position close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will struggle to make up ground in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Tricky Jenny gets a soft lead without pressure
scenarios.body: Jenny controls the tempo throughout and has enough left to resist late challengers, while the hold-up horses find too much to do in a sprint finish. The prominent runners get first run but can't match her tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Tree Wizard or Lairy Mary can improve on recent form
scenarios.body: The prominent pair get perfect trips tracking Jenny and time their runs to perfection, with Tree Wizard's cheekpieces or Lairy Mary's course form proving decisive. Jenny pays for making the running but the hold-up horses still can't get involved.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: The slow early tempo allows Penny Arcade or Spirit Of Mary to close from the back, with their superior class telling in a sprint finish. Jenny and the prominent runners get caught out by the change of tempo and tactical switch.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Jimmy You Mushroom's gelding operation has transformed him
scenarios.body: The gelded Jimmy You Mushroom shows dramatic improvement and benefits from the tactical setup, while one of the other outsiders finds significant improvement. The favourites all disappoint for various reasons.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Tricky Jenny gets seriously pressured early as no other obvious pace makes this unlikely but would transform the race
Watch Tree Wizard's cheekpieces impact as prominent runners need to improve to capitalize on tactical advantage
Watch Jimmy You Mushroom for any signs of improvement post-gelding as he's been well held in both starts
Watch the pace through early fractions as a crawling tempo would completely flip the tactical picture
Watch Penny Arcade's early positioning as she needs to overcome tactical disadvantage with superior class

races.paceDynamic: Miss Willows is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an easy lead with This Farh, In A Hurry and Thats My Boy Luke settling prominently behind her. The bulk of the field are hold-up horses including Straight A, Rajapour, Harswell Ruby, Woodstock and Coolree who will need the pace to unfold. With minimal early pressure on Miss Willows, she can control fractions and kick clear, creating a tactical scenario that strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers over the large contingent of hold-up horses who may struggle for room and pace bias.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Willows gets an uncontested lead and controls the fractions.
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal splits and prove hard to peg back despite her low rating, while the prominent This Farh can track and challenge. The hold-up brigade will struggle to make up ground on leaders who haven't been pressured.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If This Farh or In A Hurry can sit handy and time their challenge perfectly.
scenarios.body: They benefit from Miss Willows doing the donkey work while avoiding the traffic problems that will plague the rear division. Superior class tells in the final furlong against a tiring leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Miss Willows fades dramatically early.
scenarios.body: The closers get the pace injection they need to unleash their finishing kicks effectively. Coolree's course form or Straight A's recent improvement could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If early pace pressure emerges or traffic problems create unusual gaps.
scenarios.body: A horse like Sunny Orange or Yermanthere could benefit from race fall-apart or find cleaner passage than higher-rated rivals. Course specialists thrive when form horses struggle.

races.paceDynamic: Triple Force will lead from the gate with no obvious pace pressure in this small field, allowing him to dictate fractions and control the tempo throughout. With six hold-up horses behind him including recent winners Hibernate and Mao Shang Wong, the race will develop into a tactical affair with most runners settling in behind the leader. The sustained pace will suit Triple Force's frontrunning style, while the hold-up brigade will need to time their challenges perfectly from off the steady gallop. This race shape clearly favours the confirmed front runner and any prominent racers who can track the pace, as the large contingent of hold-up horses will face a tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Triple Force Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Triple Force gets an uncontested lead and maintains his rhythm
scenarios.body: He can dictate ideal fractions and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organizing their challenges behind him. His course and distance win last June proves he can execute this tactical blueprint successfully.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely steady and allows the closers to get organized
scenarios.body: The six hold-up horses can mount a coordinated late challenge with Hibernate and Mao Shang Wong leading the charge given their recent winning form. The long straight at Beverley will provide ample time for their finishing kicks to materialize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Titian can secure an ideal stalking position behind Triple Force
scenarios.body: He can benefit from the steady pace while avoiding the traffic problems that may engulf the hold-up horses in the straight. His return from 181 days off adds uncertainty but his class advantage shows through.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Triple Force goes too slow early and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where the best horse on the day can prevail regardless of running style. Form horses like Hibernate and Mao Shang Wong hold clear advantages in this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Triple Force getting a soft lead could prove decisive given the lack of pace pressure from this field composition
Hibernate's ability to get a clear run in the straight with six hold-up horses potentially causing traffic problems
Mao Shang Wong's poor record on good to firm going despite his recent winning form on softer surfaces
Titian's fitness after 181 days off and whether Tom Kiely-Marshall's 5lb claim helps offset the layoff concerns
The pace early on as Triple Force may go even slower than usual with no obvious pressure from behind

races.paceDynamic: Poet's Dawn will take this along from the front with his proven front-running style, while Penny Ghent may track him closely from her ideal low draw having just won prominently at Ripon. With most of the field preferring to come from behind (Hostelry, Berning Hot, Onemorenomore, Ring Of Gold, Princess Vivi), the pace will be steady rather than punishing. The lack of early pressure on Poet's Dawn creates a genuine tempo that will suit horses who can position handy and kick, while the strong hold-up contingent may find themselves with too much to do against the sustainable gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Duo Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Poet's Dawn and Penny Ghent get first run on the field turning for home
scenarios.body: The handy pair exploit their tactical advantage over a field of hold-up horses who struggle to make up ground on good going. Their recent Ripon form gives them a fitness edge over horses returning from longer breaks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and the leaders stop in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses finally get the collapse they need as Hostelry or Onemorenomore time their runs perfectly. Hostelry's class advantage and Onemorenomore's consistent finishing kick prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Penalty Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Poet's Dawn's 4lb penalty and recent quick return combine to flatten him out
scenarios.body: The handicapper's burden and 10-day turnaround catch up with the front-runner in the final 100 yards. Penny Ghent inherits but faces late pressure from improving types.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and an unconsidered runner gets a dream run
scenarios.body: Ring Of Gold or Princess Vivi benefit from a muddling pace that suits their modest profiles. The race falls apart tactically and allows a horse with little form to sneak through.

watchPoints.text: Poet's Dawn could get an uncontested lead if Penny Ghent doesn't go forward early enough from the inside draw
Hostelry needs a strong pace to set up her late run but most of the field wants to come from behind
Penny Ghent's low draw gives her tactical options to either lead or track Poet's Dawn closely
The good going may not provide enough give for the hold-up horses to make up significant ground
James Glennon's 7lb claim on Berning Hot could prove crucial in a tight handicap finish

races.name: Up The Tigers Handicap

runners_data.name: Freddy Robinson
runners_data.note: Sole front runner with course form advantage and two recent runner-up efforts over C&D, tactical speed to respond
runners_data.comment: Sole win on the Flat came here and he's been second over C&D on his last two outings
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win on the Flat came here over 1m2f in June 2024 and he's finished runner-up over this C&D on his last two outings; no reason why he can't go well again.

runners_data.name: Sisterandbrother
runners_data.note: Recent winner at Doncaster over this trip, hold-up style needs pace collapse but proven at the distance
runners_data.comment: Won at Doncaster this month and ran well at Southwell six days ago; now 2lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: Gained his first win for this stable at Doncaster (1m4f, good) this month and ran well at Southwell (1m3f, AW) six days ago; still fairly treated off this 2lb higher mark and has good claims.

runners_data.name: Off Spin
runners_data.note: Solid third in higher grade at Ripon, 13-race maiden but dropping back in class with Tim Easterby 9/104 strike rate
runners_data.comment: 0-13 but posted a solid effort in a higher grade than this last time; steps up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden but he posted a solid effort when third of 11 in a higher grade than this at Ripon (1m2f, good) ten days ago; can make his presence felt if staying this longer trip (unraced beyond 1m3f).

runners_data.name: Bruce Banner
runners_data.note: Winning form over trip and recent hurdles success shows fitness, needs pace to develop but capable at this level
runners_data.comment: Bounced back from a lesser effort when second at Redcar (1m6f) last time; back in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Made a winning yard debut at Newcastle (1m4f, AW) last April and he's since won over hurdles at Musselburgh in November; bounced back from a lesser effort when second of six at Redcar (1m6f, good) 20 days ago and won't mind this drop back in trip.

runners_data.name: Regal Glory
runners_data.note: Consistent efforts this year including recent runner-up at Wolverhampton, 13lb weight advantage but limited win record
runners_data.comment: 1-38 but she has posted some good efforts this year; needs to bounce back from last time
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from 38 starts came over 7f at Lingfield in 2022 but she has posted some good efforts this year, including when runner-up at Wolverhampton (1m6f, AW) last month; however, she was disappointing at Southwell (2m, AW) 29 days ago and needs to bounce back returned to this shorter trip.

runners_data.name: Rajawail
runners_data.note: 25-race maiden well held here recently, others preferred despite stepping back up in trip
runners_data.comment: 0-25 and well held here over 8.5f last time; back up in trip; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: 25-race maiden who was well held here over 8.5f (good to soft) 23 days ago; steps back up in trip and others are preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Freddy Robinson is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and will face no early pressure from the five hold-up horses behind him. Ben Robinson can dictate a sustainable gallop over this stamina-sapping 1m4f trip, setting measured fractions that will suit his mount's tactical speed. The lack of pace pressure means the tempo will be steady early before quickening in the final 3-4f when the closers make their moves. This race shape heavily favours front runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a difficult task making up ground against an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Freddy Dominates Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Freddy Robinson gets an easy lead and maintains his recent form
scenarios.body: Robinson can dictate ideal fractions and has the tactical speed to respond when challenged, having been runner-up over this C&D twice recently. The lack of early pace pressure plays directly into his hands as the proven course specialist.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and one of the hold-up horses produces a decisive late run
scenarios.body: Sisterandbrother has winning form at this trip and Off Spin showed good form when third at Ripon in higher grade. A crawling pace would set up perfectly for their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Four-Year-Old Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Off Spin's recent Ripon third translates to breakthrough form stepping back to this grade
scenarios.body: The Tim Easterby-trained four-year-old has been knocking on the door and drops in class after a solid effort against better opposition. His hold-up style needs the pace to collapse but he has the ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes tactical and one of the lower-rated runners finds unexpected improvement
scenarios.body: Bruce Banner has winning form over this trip and Regal Glory has shown good efforts this year despite her poor win record. A messy pace scenario could open the door for an upset.

watchPoints.text: Freddy Robinson getting an uncontested lead - if he dictates fractions unchallenged the hold-up horses face an impossible task
Off Spin's ability to handle the step up to 1m4f - his stamina is unproven beyond 1m2f despite recent encouraging form
How aggressively the hold-up horses are ridden early - they need to be closer than usual given the lack of pace
Sisterandbrother's quick turnaround after running six days ago - fitness advantage or too soon after Southwell effort
The early pace development in the first half-mile - if it's slower than ideal it transforms the tactical picture

races.name: Racing Again This Saturday Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Thornaby Pearl
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good recent form but faces traffic dangers with three other horses wanting similar positions
runners_data.comment: Both wins on soft but has form on good to firm; in good form; thereabouts again
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins on soft but has useful form on good to firm; has yet to race on this course but he's versatile track-wise and comes here in good form after finishing close up at Hamilton (5f, good) recently; thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Cape Sovereign
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 223 days but has course form and significant weight drop in his favour
runners_data.comment: Maiden; ran well in good sprints last spring, including over C&D; left K Ryan for £3,000
runners_data.spotlight: Not yet off the mark but he was close up in better races than this last spring, including over C&D, and has dropped a long way in the weights after a quiet end to his time with Kevin Ryan; sold £3,000 since; would come right into it if in anything approaching his best form.

runners_data.name: South Shore
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who might have won here last July but for interference, handy mark compensates for long losing run
runners_data.comment: Unlucky over C&D last July; well treated; looks to be running into form again
runners_data.spotlight: Losing run goes back nearly a year but he might have won over C&D last July but for being hampered and is on a handy mark now; a recent Tapeta run (hood left off, now refitted) suggests a good run is imminent.

runners_data.name: Nordic Glory
runners_data.note: Prominent runner switching back to 5f turf where he won before, but faces congestion issues early
runners_data.comment: Has won last two 5f runs on turf, in 2024 and this month, under J Glennon; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple AW wins; much less prolific on turf but he was running over 5f on grass for the first time since a 2024 win when getting up near the line at Bath (firm) recently under James Glennon; has an awkward draw but this track may also suit; has to be considered.

runners_data.name: King Of The Jungle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse likely needed reappearance run after 10-month break, has good course record when fit
runners_data.comment: Close 2nd in the 2024 running; better for recent comeback; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Never involved on reappearance but he'd been off for ten months and he could easily do better today, having been placed in just two C&D runs, including when going close in this race in 2024 (under Lewis Chalkley who switches to So Grateful); not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Until Dawn
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with tactical advantage, but 0-8 record on turf suggests finishing limitations
runners_data.comment: Two 5f wins on AW; 0-8 on turf; close 3rd at Hamilton but weak finish there 12 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner; two 5f wins on AW; 0-8 on turf but she didn't go down by much when third at Hamilton (5f, good) this month; she produced a much weaker finish there since, though, and her stamina will be tested on this stiffer track; yard won this in 2025.

runners_data.name: Amerjeet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose turf form doesn't match AW ability, though lower weight helps chances
runners_data.comment: Sole win on AW; no great shakes on turf so far; others higher up the list
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win on AW and his rare turf handicap runs haven't seen him to best advantage, admittedly when higher in the weights than he is now; beaten favourite four times from last six runs though and others higher up the list.

runners_data.name: So Grateful
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 283 days, has course-winning form but long absence concerns
runners_data.comment: 3lb below latest win last May; quiet end to year and off since August; perhaps other days
runners_data.spotlight: Usually leads or races prominently; two sprint wins in 2025, the latest over 6f at Thirsk (good to firm; when 3lb higher) last May, but he was quiet towards the end of the campaign and has been off since August; perhaps other days.

runners_data.name: Crafty Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse switching to new yard, 238-day break and poor recent turf form are negatives
runners_data.comment: AW winner in 2024; needs improvement on turf efforts in 2025 for new connections
runners_data.spotlight: An AW winner in 2024 for previous yard but he needs to improve on his turf efforts for new connections last year; lack of a recent run is another negative.

runners_data.name: Desert Master
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose recent Tapeta form doesn't translate to turf based on 2025 evidence
runners_data.comment: Went down narrowly on AW latest; unconvincing on turf in 2025 and well held in this race
runners_data.spotlight: Has run some good races on Tapeta this year and only just failed at Southwell (5f) in April; however, he wasn't in much form on turf in 2025, including in this race, and looks unlikely to break his turf duck.

races.paceDynamic: Until Dawn will likely lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners to pressure her early. Four horses (Thornaby Pearl, Nordic Glory, So Grateful, Desert Master) want prominent positions, creating congestion and potential traffic problems turning for home. The pace should be sustainable early before quickening, but the prominent group will create interference issues in the final 2f. This race shape favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver late kicks from clean positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn sets sustainable fractions and the prominent group gets bunched up
scenarios.body: The pace quickens gradually allowing closers to pick off tired leaders, while prominent runners get shuffled back in traffic. Cape Sovereign and King Of The Jungle benefit from clean runs wide of the pack.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn gets an easy lead and the prominent group fails to organize pressure
scenarios.body: She controls the race from pillar to post while the chasers get in each other's way behind. Nordic Glory may emerge best of the rest after avoiding the worst traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tactical battle
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners engage in early scrimmaging for position behind Until Dawn
scenarios.body: The pace becomes stop-start with constant position changes, suiting horses with tactical speed. Thornaby Pearl's experience and So Grateful's versatility help them navigate the chaos best.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wide closer strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the field goes very fast early and spreads right across the track
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong creating a blanket finish where the widest runner has the clearest path. South Shore or Crafty Spirit benefit from the most room to maneuver.

watchPoints.text: Until Dawn must be watched for signs of weakening in final furlong given her poor turf finishing record
Monitor the prominent group of Thornaby Pearl, Nordic Glory, So Grateful and Desert Master for early interference
Cape Sovereign needs watching for fitness after 223-day absence despite his obvious class advantage
King Of The Jungle should be noted for significant improvement after his reappearance pipe-opener
Watch for South Shore getting a clear run having been hampered when well-placed here before
